subcategory_text: Information is correlated from multiple sources
informative_references: CRI Profile v2.0: DE.AE-03, DE.AE-03.01, DE.AE-03.02
implementation_examples: Constantly transfer log data generated by other sources to a relatively small number of log servers
Use event correlation technology (e.g., SIEM) to collect information captured by multiple sources
Utilize cyber threat intelligence to help correlate events among log sources
assessment_objectives: Determine whether information is correlated from multiple sources.
Determine whether mechanisms ensure that constantly transfer log data generated by other sources to a relatively small number of log servers.
Determine whether activities are conducted to use event correlation technology (e.g., SIEM) to collect information captured by multiple sources.
Determine whether implementation outcomes are monitored, evaluated, and documented.
